title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Job Description – Full Stack Mobile App Developer

**Position:** Full Stack Mobile App Developer  
**Number of Vacancies:** 5  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** Chennai

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and motivated **Full Stack Mobile App Developer** with a minimum of 2 years of experience in mobile application development. The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, testing, and deploying mobile applications along with supporting backend services and APIs.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain mobile applications for Android and/or iOS platforms.
* Develop responsive, user\-friendly, and high\-performance mobile applications.
* Build and integrate **REST APIs and backend services**.
* Work with databases and ensure efficient data management.
* Integrate third\-party APIs, payment gateways, notifications, and other required services.
* Develop new features and improve existing application functionality.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues.
* Perform application testing and ensure quality before deployment.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, project coordinators, and other developers.
* Manage application deployment and updates through relevant app stores.
* Maintain clean, scalable, and well\-documented code.
* Monitor application performance and implement necessary improvements.
* Participate in project planning, development, and technical discussions.

Required Technical Skills

* Minimum **2 years of hands\-on experience** in mobile application development.
* Strong knowledge of at least one mobile development framework such as:
* Flutter
* React Native
* Android / Kotlin / Java
* iOS / Swift
* Good knowledge of frontend and backend development.
* Experience in developing and consuming **REST APIs**.
* Knowledge of databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Firebase.
* Understanding of Git/GitHub and version control.
* Knowledge of authentication, API integration, push notifications, and cloud services.
* Good understanding of mobile UI/UX principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot and optimize application performance.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in publishing applications on **Google Play Store and Apple App Store**.
* Knowledge of Firebase and cloud platforms.
* Experience with third\-party API integrations.
* Understanding of application security and data protection.
* Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines.

Candidate Profile

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to understand project requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
* Self\-motivated and willing to learn new technologies.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality applications.

Salary \& Vacancy

**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Vacancy:** 5 Position  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 Years

**Interested candidates can apply by sharing their updated resume.**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Software Engineer (Mobile development: Xamarin, MAUI)
description:
**Job Description**  

Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are working on revamping multiple platform, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by Microsoft Azure. Our clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ’s data and insights to innovate and grow. As a Mobile Engineer, you’ll be part of a team of smart, highly skilled technologists who are passionate about learning and prototyping cutting\-edge technologies. Right now our CDAR platform is concentrating on application convergence with latest cross platform mobile technologies with Xamarin and leverage Azure DevOps to support things like CI/CD and integrations. Our team is co\-located and agile, with central technology hubs in Chennai and Pune.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and implement technical solutions in Microsoft Xamarin / MAUI / .NET SDK apps using .NET ,C\# programming languages.
* Design, develop native iOS, Android Mobile applications.
* Understanding user needs and how they fit into the overall, global solution design
* Following source \& test\-driven development best practices
* Troubleshooting and identifying root cause analysis while resolving the issues

  

**Qualifications** **Must Have:**

* Experience: 4\-6 years, of which minimum 2\-3 years of hands\-on experience developing mobile Xamarin/MAUI, Native Android, Native iOS applications.
* Knowledge and experience with .NET/C\#, Java, Obj C, Swift, JavaScript, Ajax, JSON, CSS, HTML
* Solid Object\-Oriented analysis and design using common design patterns.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in any other cross platform frameworks – React Native, Flutter is an added advantage.
* Experience in MVC, MVVM design pattern and experience with anyone of the MVVM framework like Prism, MVVM Cross, MVVM Light etc, is a plus.
* Experience with local SQLite database, threading and Performance Tuning.
* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git, BitbucketAzure DevOps
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in an enterprise Agile/SCRUM environment.
* Experience in creating own custom native SDK, integrating with mobile application.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to effectively interface across cross\-functional technology teams and the business
* Excellent skills in DB Schema design and SQL development and hands on experience with ORM frameworks like Entity etc.
* Strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills.
* Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change.
* Implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests
* Teachable and embracing of best practices and feedback as a means of continuous improvement.
* Consistently high achiever marked by perseverance, humility and a positive outlook in the face of challenges.

  

**Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

description:
We are looking for a motivated Flutter Developer who will design, build and maintain high\-quality mobile applications using the Flutter framework and the Dart programming language. You will work closely with UI/UX designers, backend engineers and product stakeholders to deliver scalable, performant and user\-friendly apps.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications (iOS \& Android) using Flutter and Dart.
* Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into code that produces smooth, responsive interfaces.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, third\-party SDKs and services (Firebase, local storage, etc). Ensure code quality, performance optimization, responsiveness of apps across devices.
* Participate in code reviews, suggest best practices, maintain clean \& maintainable code base.
* Collaborate with product owners, designers, QA and operations to deliver features, bug fixes, and app releases (to App Store / Play Store
* Stay updated on new Flutter/Dart features, frameworks, architectures, state management patterns and bring them in to improve development process
* (Optional) Mentor junior developers, help set architecture decisions or build reusable custom widgets/packages.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
* Strong proficiency in Dart and the Flutter framework.
* Experience with cross\-platform mobile development for Android and iOS. Good understanding of mobile development concepts: UI/UX principles, responsive layouts, memory/performance optimization.
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs, third\-party libraries and SDKs. Familiarity with state management solutions (e.g., Provider, Bloc, GetX) and architectural patterns (MVC, MVVM, Clean Architecture).
* Experience with version control systems (Git) and modern development tooling.
* Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
